dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Hoo-whee, today's krumkakes sure are yummy. Ineffa's gotten a lot better at cooking, hasn't she?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Are we just going to leave them be?

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: Nah, they'll be fine. They're just like that, let them work things out.

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: That just means... we get to eat their share of the krumkakes!
